source_title: Micron First to Ship Critical Memory for AI Data Centers

claim_relevant_segments.shipment: validating and shipping its high-capacity monolithic 32Gb DRAM die-based 128GB DDR5 RDIMM memory
claim_relevant_segments.intel_qualification: completed Intel platform memory compatibility qualification on 4th and 5th Gen Intel® Xeon® processors

claim_relevant_visible_text:
validating and shipping its high-capacity monolithic 32Gb DRAM die-based 128GB DDR5 RDIMM memory
completed Intel platform memory compatibility qualification on 4th and 5th Gen Intel® Xeon® processors
researcher_paraphrase: Micron reported validating and shipping a 128GB DDR5 RDIMM and cited completed Intel compatibility qualification on 4th- and 5th-generation Xeon processors.
precision_guard: This establishes a Micron product shipment and platform-qualification milestone. It does not quantify market penetration, server units, customer mix or aggregate DRAM bit demand.
authority_boundary: Micron's dated release is primary for its own shipment milestone; the embedded Intel quotation is direct named-platform qualification support.
